audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].side said Diana while win[5] said Aurelion Sol, and phases[6].side said Skill while win[6] said Aurelion Sol — two rows rendering two different answers.
audit.why: phases[5].why already describes the curve bending in Aurelion Sol's favour, and the 50.6% win rate over 664 games supports Diana owning levels 1-6 and losing from the first item.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side and phases[6].side set to Aurelion Sol to match the content layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text names Shadowflame/Stormsurge as the first-item spike while report[8] builds Rod of Ages first.
audit.why: Two different first items on the same page.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[2] around Rod of Ages health and the black hole holding her off her Crescent Strike angle.

audit.whatIsWrong: The combo was described wrong in five places. Moonfall (R) was called her gap-closer and the thing that 'guarantees the follow-up Pale Cascade burst'; Lunar Rush was said to 'reset on any takedown' and to be reset by snowballing kills.
audit.why: Riot's text is explicit: Lunar Rush has no cooldown when used on an enemy afflicted with Moonlight, and Moonlight comes from Crescent Strike. Moonfall is 475 range and only pulls in enemies who are already close — it cannot open a gap-close. A player told to dodge Moonfall as the gap-closer is dodging the wrong ability; the arc of Crescent Strike is the whole trigger.
audit.corrected: Every instance rewritten to: Crescent Strike applies Moonlight, Moonlight makes Lunar Rush free, Moonfall is the 475-range finisher once she has already arrived. breakdown.cooldowns was already correct and was left alone.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flagged 'Crescent Strike' and 'Pale Cascade' as probable wrong names — both are Diana's real ability names; the flags are artefacts of the hyphenated compounds ('Crescent Strike-Pale Cascade').
audit.corrected: No name changes made on that basis; the real defect in those same strings was the combo logic, corrected above.

edits.before: Diana's Crescent Strike-into-Pale Cascade all-in punishes any Q you charge point-blank, and her shield absorbs your poke while she closes the gap with Moonfall.
edits.after: Diana's Crescent Strike marks you with Moonlight, and Lunar Rush costs no cooldown onto a marked target — the dash is free, so the arc is the thing you dodge, never the dash.

edits.before: Moonfall pulls you in and Lunar Rush resets on any takedown, giving her a level 6 all-in window that most Aurelion Sols simply cannot out-trade yet.
edits.after: Moonfall is only 475 range, so she must already be on you — and Lunar Rush resets off Moonlight, not kills. Dodge the Q arc and her level 6 combo has no opener.

edits.before: She still threatens dive windows through minions with Lunar Rush mobility, but your Shadowflame/Stormsurge spike starts giving you the range advantage to zone her out before she gets a Crescent Strike angle.
edits.after: She still threatens dive windows through minions with Lunar Rush, but Rod of Ages gives you the health to survive one full rotation, and the black hole holds her off the angle she needs for Crescent Strike.

edits.before: Land Crescent Strike into an unavoidable Pale Cascade-Moonfall combo
edits.after: Land Crescent Strike so Moonlight makes Lunar Rush cooldown-free

edits.before: Snowball kills into resetting Lunar Rush for repeated dives
edits.after: Re-mark you with Crescent Strike to chain free Lunar Rush dashes

edits.before: Item timing still favors her gap-close burst over your ramping range
edits.after: Moonfall plus a free Lunar Rush still kills you faster than R stuns her

edits.before: Diana's all-in is front-loaded and lethal if she lands Crescent Strike near a minion, since Moonfall guarantees the follow-up Pale Cascade burst before you can react. Keep wide spacing off wave, don't over-extend to farm the back minions, and treat any of her ability casts near you as an all-in signal to disengage immediately.
edits.after: Diana's all-in is front-loaded and lethal the moment Crescent Strike lands, because Moonlight makes Lunar Rush cost no cooldown — she dashes to you for free. Keep wide spacing off the wave, never line yourself up with the arc, and treat a landed Q as the signal to leave. Her Q is 8s at rank 1; that gap is your farm window.

edits.before: Level 6 is her spike, not yours — Lunar Rush lets her dash in from surprising range and reset off a kill, so hold Astral Flight purely as an escape tool through this window rather than trying to trade. Ward your flanks, avoid solo-side-lane roams, and just survive to your first completed item.
edits.after: Level 6 is her spike, not yours — Moonfall is only 475 range, so she needs Lunar Rush to arrive first, and a landed Crescent Strike makes that dash free. Hold Astral Flight purely as the escape through this window rather than trading. Ward your flanks, skip solo side-lane roams, survive to your first item.

edits.before: Carry by scaling honestly — every stardust stack is permanent, and the 30-minute version of you wins fights your laning self cannot imagine.
edits.after: Carry by outranging her: your 750 beam and 1250 R work from outside Moonfall's 475, and every fight she starts needs a Crescent Strike to land first.

edits.before: That is Diana’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: A Q-channel in dash range is a free Moonlight mark for her.

notes: ownerKit W (Astral Flight) carries a derived flag 'terrain: creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes'. Riot's own description says he flies OVER terrain — the flag is a tooltip-parse misfire. I did not write anything based on it and no existing text asserts it. Left breakdown.cooldowns alone: it was already correct that Moonlight marks reset her dash, which is the one place the page got the interaction right. dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d contain the tradeGood/tradeBad strings verbatim instead of descriptions matching their titles — same structural bug as brand and cassiopeia.
